CustomField.description: Email address(es) notified when Send_Email_On_Failure__c is true and this job ultimately fails. One address, or several separated by semicolons (e.g. email1@x.com; email2@x.com). Required whenever Send_Email_On_Failure__c is checked.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Where to send the failure notification. One address, or several separated by semicolons. Required if Send Email On Failure is checked.
CustomField.label: Notification Emails
